roster_note: 30 playable agents per playvalorant.com and Riot's official wiki (agent #08 listed as not yet playable). Newest: Tejo (v10.00, Jan 2025), Waylay (v10.04, Mar 2025), Veto (v11.07b, Oct 2025), Miks (v12.05, Mar 2026), Hush (v13.09, 2026-10-27). Waylay was briefly disabled 2026-08-08 and hotfixed 2026-08-11 per Riot wiki.

conventions.reorient_deg: Always an ESTIMATE (no source quantifies post-ability camera reorientation); reasoning in notes. null = not a reposition or not meaningful.
conventions.zoom: Only filled when Riot's wiki documents it (Chamber Headhunter x1.5). Otherwise null.
conventions.ability_source_default: Riot official wiki page for the agent (wiki.playvalorant.com/en-us/<Agent>)
conventions.engagement: Mostly ESTIMATE from role descriptions; Operator pattern for Jett/Chamber cited to a guide (opinion, not usage data). No per-agent weapon usage data was found.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.notes: Passive: aim crosshair at weapons/Spike/switches to interact from long distance. Uses look sens; not time-critical.

abilities.name: Flow
abilities.notes: Instantly create anchor; if airborne, hover briefly then propel toward anchor (Riot wiki). Distance/speed not documented. Camera presumably preserved; ESTIMATE 0-90 (new agent, no community data).

abilities.name: Flashbulb
abilities.notes: Throw flash; reactivate to direct it toward crosshair; detonates on surface/after delay. Time-critical-ish mouse steering mid-flight, normal look sensitivity (no separate setting found).

abilities.name: Displacement
abilities.notes: Thrown pull grenade, reactivate to direct toward crosshair; concusses on collisions; resets every 2 kills.

abilities.name: Suspension
abilities.notes: Fire to send forward, steer with crosshair, reactivate/fire to detonate and levitate players (Riot wiki). Levitated targets become a vertical-tracking aim problem (ESTIMATE).

engagement.style: Duelist; too new for documented engagement data
engagement.source_or_ESTIMATE: ESTIMATE (released 2026-10-27; no guides with data yet)

abilities.name: Contingency

abilities.name: Undercut

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.notes: While Focused, damaged/killed enemies drop orbs (3 s, v8.01) you must SHOOT to gain a 1-hit shield: a small-target flick/precision demand right after a kill.

abilities.name: Kill Contract
abilities.notes: Zone (length 36 m since v11.08) pulls Iso and first enemy hit into a 1v1 duel arena, 13 s. Arena size and weapon rules not on Riot wiki (community: each keeps current loadout, ESTIMATE). You are placed facing the opponent (ESTIMATE) -> small correction then a pure aim duel.

agents.name: Jett
agents.release_note: Closed Beta agent; live at game launch 2020-06-02 (v1.0). Riot wiki gives no exact date.

abilities.name: Cloudburst
abilities.notes: Thrown smoke; hold fire to steer toward crosshair (uses normal look sens). Short-duration (2.5 s travel/steer window per Riot wiki). Not time-critical aim.

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.notes: Vertical launch (height not documented). Camera preserved; usually used to peek from height then look down -> small pitch correction. reorient_deg ESTIMATE.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.notes: 0.45 s dash, 1 s windup, 7.5 s charged window (Riot wiki); distance not documented. Camera preserved (dash in movement direction). Used both as entry dash (small correction ~0-45) and post-Operator-shot escape (often 90-180 turn to retreat or re-peek). ESTIMATE: camera direction preserved through the dash (you dash where you look/move); after landing a correction toward the contested angle of ~0-90 deg is typical. Not quantified by any source.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.notes: 5 throwing knives; dmg head 150 / body 50 / legs 42 (Riot wiki) -> head is lethal, body is not: high precision demand. Kills refresh knives. Riot wiki does not state hitscan vs projectile or range (community: fast near-instant projectile, ESTIMATE). No ADS/zoom documented.

engagement.style: Entry/space-taker; aggressive Operator peeks with Tailwind escape
engagement.source_or_ESTIMATE: Operator+escape pattern: https://www.dodge.gg/en-US/valorant/news/operator-weapon-guide-2026 (guide opinion, no usage numbers); role: https://www.vstats.gg/blog/valorant_agent_roles

abilities.name: Refract

settings_found: ADS Sensitivity Multiplier (non-sniper ADS; per third-party guides, Riot introduction patch not located)
sensitivity_settings_notes.per_ability_sensitivity: None found. No Riot patch note, the Riot wiki, or settings guides (prosettings.net Oct 2026, setup.gg, edpi-calculator.org) mention a drone/ability-specific sensitivity. Guided abilities are documented as 'steer toward your crosshair' and piloted drones/cameras are first-person, so they use the normal look sensitivity (inference; no Riot doc states it explicitly).
sensitivity_settings_notes.ability_steering_toggle: Patch 9.02 (2024-07-30), CONSOLE only: High Tide, Fire Wall (Blaze), Guiding Light can be set to Toggle steering in Agent Profile Settings. This changes button behavior, not sensitivity.
sensitivity_settings_notes.zoomed_abilities: Chamber Headhunter ADS x1.5 and Tour de Force scope: which multiplier (ADS vs Scoped) applies is not documented - verify in client.
sensitivity_settings_notes.map_based_abilities: Brimstone Sky Smoke/Orbital Strike, Omen From the Shadows, Clove Ruse, Tejo Guided Salvo/Armageddon, Miks Waveform use a 'tactical map' with a cursor (Riot wiki). Look sensitivity is not the relevant control for precise map clicks (inference; cursor speed handling not documented by Riot). Omen Dark Cover is NOT map-based (first-person Shadow Vision aim).

recommender_implications_ESTIMATE: Teleport-heavy kits (Yoru, Omen, Chamber, Veto, Waylay Refract) imply frequent large (90-180 deg) post-reposition turns -> favors sens with comfortable 180 within one swipe.
Precision weapon abilities (Chamber Headhunter/TdF, Jett Blade Storm) and Operator-centric agents (Jett, Chamber) favor lower/stable sens for micro-adjustment.
Neon Overdrive is a continuous tracking weapon -> tracking demand.
Guided/piloted abilities use normal look sens, so they add no separate sens requirement beyond comfortable steering.
